notes: WhaleChat 3.76.0 — sign-up verification is email only: the SMS code card and the phone gate are removed from the signup page; the emailed 6-digit code is the single account verification (with the on-screen fallback if mail is down). Email delivery now supports Brevo, Resend and SendGrid with automatic fall-through, so one blocked provider can no longer stop verification codes, welcome mail and notifications from being sent.
